Journal of Synthetic Networks 2024;10(2):101-118

Network Embedding With Adaptive Sampling for Community Detection

Elena Vargas, Kenji Tanaka
Department of Synthetic Studies, University of Examples

Published 2024
DOI: 10.5555/synth.2024.001

Abstract
We present an adaptive sampling method for community detection in large graphs.
The approach selects landmark nodes and reconstructs embeddings efficiently.
Experiments on synthetic benchmarks show improved modularity and runtime.

Keywords: network embedding, community detection
